multi_view_availability_audit.finding: Public NGS highlight tracking (2018-2026, 17,770 plays) and historical BDB releases (2019-2026) publish 10 Hz Zebra UWB ground-truth field coordinates (single canonical coordinate stream per play), NOT multi-angle broadcast or All-22 video feeds (NFL+ Pro All-22 film is paywalled/DRM-gated). Therefore 0/787 plays have a free second camera angle in the wild; single-view calibration upgrades (Jacobian + per-play PnLCalib/TVCalib) are mandatory for real single-camera broadcast clips.

jacobian_control_experiment_single_view.model: AdaptiveKalmanJacobian (R_field = J(u,v) R_pixel J(u,v)^T + 1e-6 I_2, r_pixel_base=4.0 px^2, Q=diag(0.01,0.01,0.25,0.25))
